outcomes.text: Pick the right element for each part of a page
Write paths and alt text that still work online
Build forms and buttons everyone can use

questions.prompt: Which element should hold the main content of a page?
questions.explain: <main> holds the main content. A page should have only one <main> that is not hidden.

questions.prompt: Which attribute gives an image text that a screen reader reads out?
questions.explain: Screen readers read the alt text. It also shows if the image fails to load.

questions.prompt: Your site is at you.github.io/quiz/. Which link finds about.html in the same folder?
questions.explain: A path with no slash at the start looks next to the page. A slash at the start jumps to the top of you.github.io, where the file isn't.

questions.prompt: An input has id="name". Which label is linked to it?
questions.explain: The for attribute matches the input's id. Now a tap on the label puts the cursor in the input.

questions.prompt: Why use <button> and not a <div> with a click handler?

choices.text: A <button> works with the keyboard already
A <div> can't have a click handler

questions.explain: You can reach a <button> with Tab and press it with Space or Enter. A <div> needs extra code for that.
